svg.title: Answer-integrity check in the desktop app: one candidate answer, four signals, one flag

g.text: Answer-integrity check in the desktop app: one candidate answer, four signals, one flag
Each signal runs only when its own setting is on.
When the interviewer's question is detected
The candidate pauses (no newer speech, timer version still current)
[silent and new units since the last check]
[echo_similarity (only with an embedder of the spec model)]
[reading (only with a candidate region and gaze running)]
[ticket cancelled (newer revision started, or emergency stop)]
The flag is a signal for the interviewer, never a verdict.
Its signals list carries the evidence. Nothing about the
check reaches the candidate; audio and gaze samples are not stored.
